name: Sutra

publication_facts.pro_formats: Full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI reading require Sutra Pro.
publication_facts.komga_access: Komga access currently requires Sutra Pro.
publication_facts.cbr_status: CBR/RAR comic support is in development and planned for Pro.
publication_facts.read_aloud_status: Kokoro Read Aloud is in development for iOS and Android.
publication_facts.sync_status: Reading-progress sync through KOSync and cross-platform highlights and notes sync are being developed together for iOS and Android. Annotation-sync provider and interoperability details will be documented at launch.
publication_facts.tablet_layout: Two-page side-by-side layouts are available on iPad and Android tablets in landscape.
publication_facts.comic_spread_status: Improved comic-spread detection and page pairing are in development; these enhancements are distinct from the two-page layouts already available.

pricing.evergreen_copy: One-time Pro purchase; see your store for local pricing.
